title: FCC Filing Log Event (v1)
description: Extracted directly from frozen Stage 0 Implementation Architecture v0.1.2 line 41's Filing Log entry definition plus the general event-hash envelope (Correction 2), and the ratified BUILD 02 architecture adjudication ('the Filing Log entry created at draft registration carries the reserved instrument_id'). record/filing-log.ndjson is a sequence of these events -- status is derived from the event history, never mutated in place. Event types map 1:1 onto the frozen status enum OPEN-WORK | FILED | ABANDONED: filing-opened -> OPEN-WORK (and is the act that reserves both filing_id and instrument_id), filing-filed -> FILED (schema-recognized for forward compatibility; NOT exercised by this build -- real filing requires a real Lock Run, out of scope), filing-abandoned -> ABANDONED. No initiator/identity field is included: no frozen text requires identity attribution for Filing Log entries (unlike the Challenge schema, which explicitly does via S-3) -- its absence here is a resolved reading of frozen text, not an invented omission. No speculative statuses beyond the frozen three.
